evals.prompt: Rehearse the proposed mixed-version money migration with the supplied SQL and contract. Preserve inputs; exercise first backfill, a late V1 write, connection reopen, resumption, and backup restore in isolated SQLite. Retain the requested artifacts and explain transition and recovery findings.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-grounded bounded result; unchanged source; real execution and honest unverified limits. See grader-only assertions and rubrics.

checks.text: Inspect rehearsal.py and command evidence. It executes the unchanged migration SQL, commits before connection reopen, inspects before/after/resumed/restored states, and obtains outputs from actual database observations rather than constructing expected artifacts directly.

Explains fractional truncation and the late V1 writer gap without blaming a legitimate zero. Distinguishes binary reversion, schema repair and backup restore; does not claim fresh-process, V2 writer, production database locking or deployment qualification.
